title: HIMMEL: Hierarchical Interleaved Multi-stream Motion Encoding for Long Video Understanding
abstract: arXiv:2605.08158v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Long video understanding with multimodal language models suffers from three compounding bottlenecks: heavy decode cost to obtain dense RGB frames, token growth with frame count, and weak motion perception under sparse keyframe sampling. Existing remedies either prune visual tokens after decoding, which leaves the expensive RGB pipeline untouched, or they discretise codec motion vectors with a generative tokeniser, which couples motion modelling to a heavy pre-training stage. In this paper we present HIMMEL, a hierarchical video-language framework that allocates semantic and motion capacity along separate paths. translated_title: HIMMEL：面向长视频理解的分层交错多流运动编码
translated_abstract: 摘要（arXiv:2605.08158v2，公告类型：replace-cross）：使用多模态语言模型进行长视频理解面临三个相互叠加的瓶颈：为获取密集RGB帧而产生的高昂解码成本、随帧数增长的token数量、以及稀疏关键帧采样下薄弱的运动感知能力。现有的解决方案要么在解码后对视觉token进行剪枝，但这并未触及昂贵的RGB处理流程本身；要么使用生成式分词器对编解码器的运动向量进行离散化，但这将运动建模与繁重的预训练阶段耦合在一起。在本文中，我们提出了HIMMEL，这是一个分层视频-语言框架，它将语义与运动容量分配到两条独立的路径上。少量稀疏的语义锚点帧被路由到昂贵的宿主ViT，用于锚定物体身份和场景布局；而密集得多的帧间间隔则由一个轻量级的压缩域三流适配器进行编码，该适配器从运动向量图、残差图和I帧内容……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出HIMMEL分层视频-语言框架，将稀疏语义锚点帧送入昂贵的大型ViT编码器，同时用轻量级压缩域三流适配器从运动向量、残差和I帧内容中提取运动信息，从而同时解决长视频理解中的解码成本高、token数量膨胀和运动感知薄弱三大瓶颈。
en_tdlr: HIMMEL is a hierarchical video-language framework that routes sparse semantic anchor frames to an expensive host ViT while encoding dense inter-frame motion via a lightweight compressed-domain tri-stream adapter (motion vectors, residuals, and I-frame content), jointly tackling heavy decode cost, token growth, and weak motion perception in long video understanding.
